author: yeahdongcn
body:
The main reason for this change is not only replacing `torch.cuda.device`.

The existing `device.type == "cuda"` check is a hard CUDA-only allowlist. I kept the CUDA behavior and added MUSA only after validating deterministic RNG behavior on real MUSA hardware. Other accelerator types still use the CPU-only fallback because their device RNG semantics have not been validated.
